description: This file defines the ShippingService interface in a Java e-commerce application. It declares methods for managing shipping configurations, retrieving shipping options, calculating shipping quotes, package details, and handling custom shipping configurations for merchant stores.

classes.name: ShippingService
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for managing shipping configurations, obtaining shipping options and quotes, handling custom configurations, and calculating shipping summaries in the context of a merchant store.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries supported for shipping, configured by the merchant store, typically for local domestic shipping.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of supported shipping countries for a merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of available shipping modules for a given merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping modules that have been configured for the merchant store.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration details for a specific shipping quote module.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves shipping configuration for a merchant store.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves shipping configuration settings for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a particular shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed package information for a set of shipping products, used to generate shipping quotes.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns a shipping quote based on store, delivery, products, and language.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom shipping configuration details for a module.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes custom shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Builds a shipping summary from a selected shipping quote and option, used for order calculations.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves list of countries to which the merchant store ships, based on configuration.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines whether shipping is required for the items in the shopping cart.
